name: io.github.nileshmakan2/agentstall
title: AgentStall: Africa and India data
description: Pay-per-call data for Africa, India and emerging markets: holidays, VAT, rates, IDs, codes.

tools.name: agentstall_catalog
tools.description: Free. Lists every paid tool with its price in USDC, payment network and an example result.

tools.name: public_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays API: public and bank holidays for any country and year (220+ countries by ISO code), with date and English name. Covers the US, UK, Europe, India, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, China, Japan, Brazil and all of Africa. South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana and 6 more African countries use AgentStall's verified calendars with observed days and declared Islamic holidays. Free open sources: Nager.Date and date-holidays. Useful for scheduling, payroll and deadlines. Returns JSON with country, year, count, holidays. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

year.description: Calendar year (South Africa 1995-2100; 10 verified African countries 2026-2027; other countries 2000-2040)

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. ZA (default), NG, KE, EG, IN, AE, SA, US, GB, DE, BR, CN (220+ countries). Verified calendars for ZA, NG, KE, EG, GH, MA, RW, UG, TZ, MU and BW

tools.name: is_business_day
tools.description: Is it a business day? Checks whether a date is a business (working) day in any of 220+ countries and says why not: weekend or which public holiday. Returns the next and previous business days. Handles local weekends (Friday-Saturday in Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Israel) and observed holidays, with verified calendars for South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt and 7 more African countries. Useful for payment, settlement and delivery dates. Returns JSON with date, weekday, isBusinessDay, reason, nextBusinessDay, previousBusinessDay. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. ZA (default), NG, KE, EG, IN, AE, SA, US, GB, DE, BR, CN (220+ countries). Verified calendars for ZA, NG, KE, EG, GH, MA, RW, UG, TZ, MU and BW

tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: Business days calculator: adds or subtracts working days from a date in any of 220+ countries, skipping weekends and public holidays, and lists the holidays skipped. Local weekends supported (e.g. Friday-Saturday in Saudi Arabia and Egypt). Verified calendars for South Africa and 10 African countries. Useful for payment terms such as 'net 5 business days', notice periods, SLAs, delivery estimates and legal deadlines. Returns JSON with start, businessDaysAdded, result, resultWeekday, holidaysSkipped. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. ZA (default), NG, KE, EG, IN, AE, SA, US, GB, DE, BR, CN (220+ countries). Verified calendars for ZA, NG, KE, EG, GH, MA, RW, UG, TZ, MU and BW

tools.name: count_business_days
tools.description: Working days calculator: counts the business days between two dates in any of 220+ countries, excluding weekends and public holidays, and lists the holidays excluded. Local weekends supported. Verified calendars for South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana and 6 more African countries. Useful for SLAs, turnaround times, leave days and deadlines measured in business days. Returns JSON with from, to, businessDays, calendarDays. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

to.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), within 5 years of 'from'

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. ZA (default), NG, KE, EG, IN, AE, SA, US, GB, DE, BR, CN (220+ countries). Verified calendars for ZA, NG, KE, EG, GH, MA, RW, UG, TZ, MU and BW

tools.name: za_school_calendar
tools.description: South African public school calendar: term dates and school holidays for 2026 and 2027 from the Department of Basic Education, special school holidays, and whether a given date is a school day. Useful for family travel, childcare, events and education planning in South Africa. Returns JSON with date, isSchoolDay, reason, term, termEnds. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

year.description: Optional year (2026-2027) to list the terms; defaults to the date's year or the current year

tools.name: za_sars_deadlines
tools.description: South African tax deadlines from SARS between two dates: EMP201 PAYE/UIF/SDL payments, VAT201 returns, provisional tax (IRP6), EMP501 reconciliations and income tax filing-season deadlines, already moved to the previous business day where SARS rules require it. Useful for payroll, bookkeeping, accounting and tax compliance reminders in South Africa. Returns JSON with count, deadlines. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, at most 400 days after 'from' (default: from + 90 days)

tools.name: za_tender_search

Filter by keyword, closing date, category and buyer. Returns tender number, description, buyer, procurement method, opening and closing dates, and tender document links. Updated every 3 hours. Returns JSON with country, totalMatches, indexedTenders, results. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

buyer.description: Part of the buyer's name, e.g. 'Municipality' or 'Transnet'

tools.name: za_sarb_rates
tools.description: South African interest rates, inflation and rand exchange rates from the South African Reserve Bank (SARB): repo rate, prime lending rate, CPI and PPI inflation, and rand (ZAR) per US dollar, pound, euro and yen, each with its as-of date. Useful for loan and interest calculations, pricing in rand and economic context. Returns JSON with rates. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

tools.name: exchange_rates

tools.name: za_validate_id_number
tools.description: South African ID number validation: checks a 13-digit SA ID number (date of birth, citizenship digit and Luhn checksum) and decodes date of birth, age, gender and citizenship status. Structural check only, with no Home Affairs lookup; the number is not stored. Useful for KYC and onboarding forms and for catching typos. Returns JSON with valid, decoded. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

tools.name: za_validate_tax_number
tools.description: South African tax number validation: checks a 10-digit SARS VAT registration number or income tax reference number (format and modulus-10 check digit) and says which type it is. Format check only, not a SARS registration lookup; nothing is stored. Useful for invoices, supplier onboarding and form validation. Returns JSON with valid, type, normalized. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

number.description: VAT or income tax number; spaces, dashes and slashes are ignored

tools.name: za_validate_company_number
tools.description: South African company registration number check: validates a CIPC registration number (YYYY/NNNNNN/NN) and decodes the registration year and entity type, such as (Pty) Ltd, Ltd, NPC, Inc, CC, co-operative or SOC. Format check only, not a CIPC status lookup. Useful for supplier onboarding, invoices and tender paperwork. Returns JSON with valid, formatted, registrationYear, entityType. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

tools.name: za_normalize_phone
tools.description: South African phone number formatting and classification: converts an SA number in any common format to international +27 (E.164) and local formats, and says whether it is mobile, landline (with area for major cities), toll-free, VoIP or premium-rate. Useful for cleaning contact lists, SMS and WhatsApp messaging, and form validation. Returns JSON with valid, e164, national, type. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

number.description: Phone number in any common format, e.g. 082 123 4567 or +27 11 555 1234

tools.name: africa_incident_reporting_obligations
tools.description: Data breach and cyber incident reporting obligations in South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana, Morocco, Rwanda, Uganda, Tanzania, Mauritius and Botswana: which regulators and people must be notified, the legal deadline (such as 72 hours) and the computed due time from discovery. Covers POPIA and FSCA/PA rules in South Africa, NDPA and ngCERT in Nigeria, and Kenya's Data Protection Act. Triage guidance, not legal advice. Returns JSON with obligations, notYetInForce. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

country.description: Country code: ZA (default), NG, KE, EG, GH, MA, RW, UG, TZ, MU or BW

critical_infrastructure.description: Outside South Africa: are you a designated critical / vital infrastructure operator? Omit if unknown

sector.description: South Africa only. Organisation type: general (any private business), bank, mutual_bank, insurer, financial_other (other FSCA-regulated institutions covered by Joint Standard 1 of 2023 or 2 of 2024, e.g. market infrastructures, certain FSPs, pension funds), public_body, ecsp (electronic communications service provider).
